MI_Gnome_PR_Skin.shading: subsurface profile / skin; SSS.rgb = scatter colour x thickness
MI_Gnome_PR_Skin.normal: OpenGL (+Y), flip green for UE as the existing importer does

MI_Gnome_PR_Eyes.shading: default lit, low roughness from ORM.G; single-shell eye with modelled cornea bulge

MI_Gnome_PR_Hair.shading: hair shading model, MASKED (alpha in BC.a, clip about 0.33 with dithered opacity / TAA), two-sided; cap shell + lock cards + brow and lash cards in one slot
MI_Gnome_PR_Hair.anisotropy: FLOW.rg = strand direction in UV space, encoded 0.5 + 0.5 * d (root to tip): world tangent = normalize(d.x * dP/du + d.y * dP/dv); use it as the hair tangent / anisotropy direction so highlights run along the hair. Baked from the strand groom (cap rect) and from the strand clumps (card tiles). N is the strand-relief normal (OpenGL), ORM.r = strand depth occlusion, ORM.g = roughness.
MI_Gnome_PR_Hair.masks: FLOW.b = back-light mask (0 on the opaque cap shell, 1 on cards: scale back-scatter / two-sided transmission by it). MSK.r = strand depth, MSK.g = per-strand id (use for per-strand colour / roughness jitter), MSK.b = root-to-tip gradient (0 root, 1 tip; the BC already carries a root-dark to tip-light gradient).
MI_Gnome_PR_Hair.atlas_layout: uv: cap texture u 0-0.5, v 0.5-1 (whole groom projected about the head centre, opaque under-fill inside the hairline); 32 narrow lock tiles u 0.5-1, v 0.25-1 (root at top); 4 wide tiles u 0-0.5, v 0.25-0.5; brow groom band u 0-0.5, v 0-0.25; lash band u 0.5-1, v 0-0.25
MI_Gnome_PR_Hair.shell_order: vertex attribute hl (also the build order, inner first): 1 = cap shell (opaque, never drop, casts the shadow), 2 = mid lock cards, 3 = outer lock cards, 4 = brows and lashes, 5 = hairline wisps and flyaways. LOD1 keeps all, LOD2 drops 5, LOD3 keeps 1, 3, 4. Custom split normals are scalp-blended and exported in the FBX: import normals, do not recompute.

known_weaknesses: The tunic, the belt, the boots and the hat are those of the Unclaimed source, carried onto the rig by its own skin weights: swept shapes with a painted weave, no cloth simulation.
His hands are the hero's at the rig's size: after the placement they are half a man's, where the 1997 gnome has large hands.
Hair and beard are cards rigid on the head bone: the beard does not swing and a deep nod carries it into the belly.
The hat is rigid on the head bone; its point does not sway.
The face is sculpted with the kit's face operations (cfg/head.json): an old gnome of no particular likeness.
